"""Bounded source-only truth audit. Run from the repository root; no detector."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess

import cv2
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageOps

ROOT = Path.cwd()
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def sha(path):
    with Path(path).open('rb') as handle:
        return hashlib.file_digest(handle, 'sha256').hexdigest()


def save_json(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')


def sheet(tiles, path, columns=3):
    result = Image.new('RGB', (columns * 420, ((len(tiles) + columns - 1) // columns) * 450), '#202020')
    for i, (rgb, title) in enumerate(tiles):
        tile = Image.new('RGB', (420, 450), '#202020')
        # Nearest-neighbor enlargement is display only and creates no evidence.
        thumb = ImageOps.contain(rgb, (410, 408), Image.Resampling.NEAREST)
        tile.paste(thumb, ((420 - thumb.width) // 2, 37 + (408 - thumb.height) // 2))
        ImageDraw.Draw(tile).text((9, 9), title, fill='white')
        result.paste(tile, ((i % columns) * 420, (i // columns) * 450))
    result.save(path)


inventory_path = Path('sample/output/s11-local-target-reuse-20261006/inventory.json')
inventory = json.loads(inventory_path.read_text())
assert sha(inventory_path) == 'ca6c0a50e7360d5079864abc7bb9854e45bdf7058d0cf452f84e29e79a3ba3cf'
pins = json.loads(Path('docs/50-diagnostics/s11/s11-a-opencv-evidence-architecture-probe-manifest.json').read_text())['inputs']
d1_path = Path('sample/output/s6-d1-mobile-truth-review-pack/worker-0f0bf70-20260731T151330Z/review-candidates.json')
assert sha(d1_path) == '2dcf7190fd143716045ed6cddc7f2d166fd07d46c7819a84691d477094e67aee'
d1 = {r['review_id']: r for r in json.loads(d1_path.read_text())['items']}
extra = {'base_sample_1': [0, 150, 151, 433], 'sample2': [90, 180, 285],
         'sample3': [0, 1800, 2250, 4198], 'sample4': [1275, 1320, 1560, 1620, 1665]}
inputs = {str(inventory_path): sha(inventory_path), str(d1_path): sha(d1_path)}
plans = []
for stem, extra_frames in extra.items():
    for ext in ('mp4', 'oilrecipe', 'oiltruth'):
        path = Path(f'sample/{stem}.{ext}')
        inputs[str(path)] = sha(path)
        assert inputs[str(path)] == pins[stem][ext], str(path)
    recipe = json.loads(Path(f'sample/{stem}.oilrecipe').read_text())
    ellipse = recipe['glasses'][0]['geometry']['ellipse']
    cap = cv2.VideoCapture(f'sample/{stem}.mp4')
    assert cap.isOpened()
    reported_count = int(cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_COUNT)); fps = cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS)
    # Existing S6 sequential-decode last frames; metadata can overstate length.
    count = {'base_sample_1': 434, 'sample2': 286, 'sample3': 4199, 'sample4': 1682}[stem]
    width = int(cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_WIDTH)); height = int(cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_HEIGHT))
    cap.release()
    rows = [r for r in inventory['rows'] if r['sample'] == stem]
    delta = round(fps * .5)
    triplets = [[max(0, r['frame_index'] - delta), r['frame_index'], min(count - 1, r['frame_index'] + delta)] for r in rows]
    targets = sorted(set(extra_frames).union(*(set(t) for t in triplets)))
    cx, cy, rx, ry = [ellipse[k] for k in ('center_x', 'center_y', 'radius_x', 'radius_y')]
    crop = [max(0, int(cx - rx * 1.35)), max(0, int(cy - ry * 1.35)),
            min(width, int(cx + rx * 1.35)), min(height, int(cy + ry * 1.35))]
    plans.append(dict(stem=stem, count=count, reported_count=reported_count, fps=fps, source_size=[width,height],
                      ellipse=ellipse, display_crop_xyxy=crop, reviewed=rows,
                      triplets=triplets, geometry_context_frames=extra_frames, target_frames=targets))
preflight = dict(schema='s11-truth-source-audit-preflight-v1', base_head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),
                 inputs=inputs, plans=plans, selection='All 15 existing annotation frames with +/-0.5s context, plus declared geometry/overlay/known-event context. No score-based filtering.',
                 exposure='Existing labels and prior results were already seen; clean rendering is not a blinded independent review.',
                 outputs='Sequential native decoding, raw BGR hashes, clean native PNGs and display-only nearest-neighbor crops. No boundary overlays.',
                 detector_run=False, labels_changed=False, physical_coordinates_created=False)
save_json(OUT / 'preflight.json', preflight)
reports=[]
for plan in plans:
    stem=plan['stem']; folder=OUT/stem; folder.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    cap=cv2.VideoCapture(f'sample/{stem}.mp4'); records={}; frames={}
    wanted=set(plan['target_frames']); i=0
    while i <= max(wanted):
        ok,bgr=cap.read(); assert ok,(stem,i)
        if i in wanted:
            target=folder/f'f{i:06d}.png'; assert cv2.imwrite(str(target),bgr)
            records[i]=dict(frame_index=i, decoded_timestamp_sec=cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC)/1000,
                            backend_next_frame=cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES), shape=list(bgr.shape),
                            bgr_sha256=hashlib.sha256(bgr.tobytes()).hexdigest(), path=str(target), sha256=sha(target))
            frames[i]=Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(bgr,cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB))
        i+=1
    cap.release(); assert set(records)==wanted
    tiles=[]
    for row, triplet in zip(plan['reviewed'], plan['triplets'], strict=True):
        row['original_agent_proposal']=d1[row['review_id']]['candidate_physical']
        row['fresh_timestamp_delta_sec']=records[row['frame_index']]['decoded_timestamp_sec']-row['timestamp_sec']
        for frame in triplet:
            tiles.append((frames[frame].crop(plan['display_crop_xyxy']), f"{row['review_id']} | f{frame} | {records[frame]['decoded_timestamp_sec']:.3f}s"))
    target=OUT/f'{stem}-annotation-context.png'; sheet(tiles,target)
    context=[]
    for frame in plan['geometry_context_frames']:
        context.append((frames[frame],f'{stem} full source | f{frame}'))
        context.append((frames[frame].crop(plan['display_crop_xyxy']),f'{stem} fixed display crop | f{frame}'))
    overview=OUT/f'{stem}-geometry-context.png'; sheet(context,overview,columns=2)
    reports.append(dict(**plan, frames=list(records.values()),
                        annotation_sheet=dict(path=str(target),sha256=sha(target)),
                        geometry_sheet=dict(path=str(overview),sha256=sha(overview))))
    print(stem, len(records), 'unique source frames saved',flush=True)
assert all(sha(p)==h for p,h in inputs.items())
record=dict(schema='s11-truth-source-audit-capture-v1', preflight_sha256=sha(OUT/'preflight.json'),
            runtime=dict(opencv=cv2.__version__,numpy=np.__version__), inputs_preserved=True,
            decoded_selected_frame_count=sum(len(r['frames']) for r in reports), reports=reports,
            script_sha256=sha(__file__), detector_run=False, physical_truth_assigned=False)
save_json(OUT/'capture.json',record)
print('complete:', record['decoded_selected_frame_count'], 'selected frames; source inputs unchanged')
